<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
:root{
  --sage:#C7D2BB;
  --ink:#24231F;
  --plaster:#F2F3ED;
  --timber:#B0844F;
  --deep:#5E6B4E;

  --pad:clamp(20px,4.2vw,60px);
  --gap:clamp(14px,1.6vw,22px);
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--plaster);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:Inter,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(14px,1.05vw,16px);
  line-height:1.55;
  font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,p,figure,blockquote{margin:0}

.wordmark{
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:clamp(30px,9.15vw,132px);
  line-height:.9;
  letter-spacing:-.015em;
  font-weight:500;
  max-width:100%;
  overflow-wrap:break-word;
}
.title{
  font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,19px);
  line-height:1.2;
  letter-spacing:.045em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;
}
.panel__t{
  font-size:clamp(19px,1.9vw,26px);
  line-height:1.2;
  letter-spacing:.05em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;
}
.panel__s{
  font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px);
  color:var(--deep);
  margin-top:8px;
}
.lede{
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,21px);
  line-height:1.45;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
  font-weight:400;
  max-width:44ch;
}
.micro{
  font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;
}
.body{max-width:58ch}
.body p + p{margin-top:1em}

.spread{
  border-top:1px dotted rgba(36,35,31,.42);
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
  padding-top:12px;
}
.on-ink .spread{border-top-color:rgba(242,243,237,.42)}

@media (max-width:640px){
  .spread{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px 18px}
}

.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  text-decoration:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:inherit;
  font-size:clamp(11px,.9vw,13px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;
  padding:14px 22px;border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--plaster);
  transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease;
}
.btn::after{content:"+";font-size:1.15em;line-height:0;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn:hover,.btn:focus-visible{background:var(--timber);color:var(--ink)}
.btn--light{background:var(--plaster);color:var(--ink)}
.btn--light:hover,.btn--light:focus-visible{background:var(--timber)}
.explore{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;
  font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;
}
.explore::after{content:"+";opacity:.75}
.explore:hover,.explore:focus-visible{color:var(--deep)}

.band--sage .explore:hover,.band--sage .explore:focus-visible{color:var(--ink)}

.nav{
  position:absolute;top:clamp(14px,1.8vw,26px);left:clamp(14px,1.8vw,26px);z-index:20;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,44px);
  background:var(--plaster);
  padding:12px 16px;border-radius:6px;
}
.nav__logo{width:clamp(104px,9vw,128px);height:auto}
.nav__links{display:flex;gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,20px)}
.nav__links a{
  text-decoration:none;
  font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;
}

.nav__links a:hover,.nav__links a:focus-visible{color:var(--deep)}
.nav__cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.nav__menu{display:none;appearance:none;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;border-radius:0}

@media (max-width:900px){

  .nav{position:relative;top:0;left:0;border-radius:0;width:100%;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}

  .nav:has(+ .hero){position:absolute;top:0;left:0}
  .nav__links{
    display:none;

    order:1;flex-basis:100%;
    position:static;
    flex-direction:column;gap:0;
    background:var(--plaster);
    padding:4px 16px 14px;

    box-shadow:0 18px 36px -22px rgba(36,35,31,.4);
  }
  .nav--open .nav__links,html:not(.js) .nav__links{display:flex}
  .nav__links a{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(36,35,31,.28)}
  .nav__links a:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .nav__menu{display:inline-flex}

  html:not(.js) .nav__menu{display:none}
}

.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink)}
.hero__media{position:absolute;inset:0}
.hero__media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

.hero__media::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(36,35,31,.30) 0%,rgba(36,35,31,0) 24%,rgba(36,35,31,.06) 44%,rgba(36,35,31,.55) 72%,rgba(36,35,31,.82) 100%);
}
.hero__inner{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:var(--pad);color:var(--plaster);width:100%}
.hero__eyebrow{position:absolute;top:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);right:var(--pad);z-index:2;color:var(--sage)}

.hero__inner > p.micro{
  display:inline-block;
  background:var(--ink);
  padding:7px 12px 6px;
}
.hero .spread{border-top-color:rgba(242,243,237,.55);color:var(--plaster);margin-bottom:clamp(16px,2.4vw,28px)}

.hero__mark{margin-bottom:clamp(14px,2vw,22px)}

.hero__foot{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:clamp(26px,3vw,36px) 24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero__sub{color:var(--sage);max-width:38ch}
.hero__sub + .hero__foot{margin-top:clamp(26px,3vw,36px)}

.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:min(78vh,760px)}
@media (max-width:820px){.duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.duo__img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink);min-height:52vh}
.duo__img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.duo:hover .duo__img img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.duo__panel{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;
  padding:clamp(36px,6vw,84px) clamp(24px,5vw,72px);
  gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,28px);
}
.duo__panel--sage{background:var(--sage)}

.duo__panel--sage .panel__s{color:var(--ink)}
.duo__panel--plaster{background:var(--plaster)}
.duo__panel--ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--plaster)}
.duo__panel--ink .panel__s{color:var(--sage)}

.duo__panel--deep{background:var(--deep);color:var(--plaster)}
.duo__panel--deep .panel__s{color:var(--plaster)}

.duo__panel--deep .explore:hover,.duo__panel--deep .explore:focus-visible,
.duo__panel--ink .explore:hover,.duo__panel--ink .explore:focus-visible{
  color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;
}
.duo__inset{width:min(260px,72%);aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden}
.duo__inset img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.duo__body{max-width:42ch;font-size:clamp(13px,1.05vw,15px)}

.duo--routes{min-height:min(46vh,420px)}

.duo--routes + .band--ink{border-top:1px dotted rgba(242,243,237,.42)}

.band{padding:clamp(48px,7vw,104px) var(--pad)}
.band--sage{background:var(--sage)}
.band--ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--plaster)}
.band__head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:clamp(24px,3.4vw,44px)}

.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:var(--gap)}
@media (max-width:820px){.grid3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.grid3--two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
@media (max-width:820px){.grid3--two{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tile{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;display:block}
.tile__img{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink)}
.tile__img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.tile:hover .tile__img img,.tile:focus-visible .tile__img img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.tile__chip{
  position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;
  background:var(--plaster);color:var(--ink);
  padding:5px 10px;border-radius:4px;
}
.tile__n{margin-top:12px;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500}
.tile__m{margin-top:4px;font-size:clamp(11px,.92vw,13px);color:var(--deep)}
.band--ink .tile__m{color:var(--sage)}

.band--sage .tile__m{color:var(--ink)}

.roll{border-top:1px dotted rgba(36,35,31,.42);padding-top:clamp(18px,2.4vw,26px)}
.band--ink .roll{border-top-color:rgba(242,243,237,.42)}

.roll{--roll-n:clamp(190px,37%,360px);--roll-x:auto}
.roll__row,.roll__head{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,var(--roll-n)) minmax(0,1fr) var(--roll-x);
  align-items:baseline;
  column-gap:clamp(11px,1.4vw,18px);row-gap:clamp(6px,.8vw,10px);
  padding:clamp(14px,1.9vw,22px) 0;
}
.roll__n{grid-column:1}
.roll__m{grid-column:2}
.roll__x{grid-column:3}

.roll__row{border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(36,35,31,.28)}
.band--ink .roll__row{border-bottom-color:rgba(242,243,237,.28)}

.roll--therapies .roll__row{display:block;padding:0}
.roll__head{
  width:100%;background:none;border:0;text-align:left;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;
}
.roll__n{
  font-size:clamp(21px,2.9vw,40px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500;
  transition:color .32s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.2,1),transform .32s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.2,1);
}
.roll__m{font-size:clamp(11px,.86vw,12px);color:var(--deep);max-width:34ch}
.band--ink .roll__m{color:var(--sage)}

.band--sage .roll__m{color:var(--ink)}
.roll__x{margin-left:auto;font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}

.roll__head:hover .roll__n,.roll__head:focus-visible .roll__n,
.roll__row.is-open .roll__n{color:var(--ink);transform:translateX(6px)}
.roll__head:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--timber);outline-offset:4px}

.roll--menu .roll__x{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;text-align:right}
.roll__p{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,15px);letter-spacing:.06em;white-space:nowrap;text-transform:none}

.roll__p--alt{color:#666661;font-size:clamp(11px,.84vw,12px)}
.band--sage .roll__p--alt{color:var(--ink)}
.band--ink .roll__p--alt{color:var(--sage)}
.roll--menu .roll__n{font-size:clamp(19px,2.1vw,30px)}
.roll--menu .roll__m{max-width:40ch}

.roll--menu{--roll-n:clamp(200px,44%,450px)}

.roll--rates .roll__x{display:flex;gap:clamp(16px,3vw,44px);align-items:flex-start;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.rate{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:right;min-width:clamp(56px,6vw,84px)}
.rate__v{font-size:clamp(14px,1.3vw,19px);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.rate__k{font-size:clamp(11px,.72vw,11px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--deep)}

.band--sage .rate__k{color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .roll--rates .roll__x{width:100%;margin-left:0;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
  .rate{min-width:0}
}

@media (max-width:1080px){
  .roll__row,.roll__head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) var(--roll-x)}
  .roll__n{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
  .roll__m{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}
  .roll__x{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 2;align-self:start}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .roll__row,.roll__head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .roll__n{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
  .roll__m{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}
  .roll__x{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;align-self:auto;margin-left:0}
  .roll--menu .roll__x{align-items:flex-start;text-align:left}
}

.roll--plans .roll__row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start;row-gap:0}
.roll--plans .roll__n{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
.roll--plans .roll__m{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;max-width:64ch;margin-top:10px}
.roll--plans .roll__x{
  grid-column:1;grid-row:3;align-self:auto;margin-left:0;
  margin-top:clamp(16px,2vw,24px);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(8px,1.1vw,16px);
  text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:inherit;
}
.roll--plans .rate{text-align:left;min-width:0;gap:0;padding:clamp(12px,1.4vw,18px)}
.roll--plans .rate--best{background:var(--plaster)}

.rate__u{font-size:clamp(11px,.72vw,11px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;color:var(--deep)}
.rate__s{margin-top:10px;font-size:clamp(11px,.92vw,13px);line-height:1.45;color:var(--deep)}
.band--sage .rate__u,.band--sage .rate__s{color:var(--ink)}
.band--sage .rate--best .rate__k,
.band--sage .rate--best .rate__u,
.band--sage .rate--best .rate__s{color:var(--deep)}

@media (max-width:700px){
  .roll--plans .roll__x{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}
  .roll--plans .rate{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;
    column-gap:14px;align-items:baseline;padding:11px 13px;

<section class="band band--sage" data-chapter="What it feels like" id="s01" aria-label="What it feels like">
  <div>
    <div class="says">
      <div class="body">
        <h2 class="lede">What it feels like.</h2>
        <p style="margin-top:22px">You sit on the chair in the clothes you came in. You'll feel a firm, rhythmic pulsing in the muscles you're sitting on. It should feel strong, but not sharp. It runs in bursts with short pauses in between.</p>
        <p>You can talk, read or just sit while your muscles work.</p>
        <p>Many people book it for pelvic floor support. Nothing is internal, and you stay seated and dressed. If you have any questions, ring us before you come in.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="tile__img"><img src="/sites/optimal-health/assets/hifem-session-seated.jpg" alt="A client seated on the HIFEM chair in her own clothes" loading="lazy" /></div>
    </div>
    <div class="cols4" data-stagger style="margin-top:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px)">
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">01</p><p class="cell__v">Come in your normal clothes. You don't need to change.</p></div>
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">02</p><p class="cell__v">A member of our team sets you up and starts the intensity low.</p></div>
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">03</p><p class="cell__v">You sit for twenty to thirty minutes. Tell us if you want it lower and we'll turn it down.</p></div>
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">04</p><p class="cell__v">Have a glass of water afterwards. You can drive, work or train after your session.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band--ink on-ink">
  <div class="says">
    <div class="band__head__l">
      <p class="title">In their words</p>
      <figure style="margin:22px 0 0">
        <blockquote class="says__t" style="margin:0 0 18px">“It has made a huge difference to me physically and mentally. It's given me my freedom back.”</blockquote>
        <figcaption class="says__a">Deirdre Cronin · HIFEM client</figcaption>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band" data-chapter="How it works" id="s02" aria-label="How it works">
  <div>
    <div class="band__head">
      <div class="band__head__l">
        <h2 class="lede">How it works.</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <ul class="vitals" data-stagger>
      <li>
        <p class="vitals__k">Session length</p>
        <p class="vitals__v">20–30 minutes</p>
        <p class="vitals__m">Seated, fully clothed, with nothing to change into.</p>
      </li>
      <li>
        <p class="vitals__k">How often</p>
        <p class="vitals__v">Two or three a week</p>
        <p class="vitals__m">For a few weeks. Results build over a run of sessions.</p>
      </li>
      <li>
        <p class="vitals__k">Mostly booked for</p>
        <p class="vitals__v">Pelvic floor support</p>
        <p class="vitals__m">People also book it for stiff hips, a stiff lower back, and core muscles that are hard to work on their own.</p>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div class="says">
      <div class="body">
        <p>HIFEM creates a focused magnetic field. It passes through your clothes and skin and makes the muscle contract. This is why you can stay dressed.</p>
        <p>It can produce thousands of contractions in a session. That's more than you could do on your own. It also reaches muscles that are hard to contract on purpose. The pelvic floor is one example. Many people can't feel it well enough to exercise it properly.</p>
        <p>As with any muscle work, results build over a number of sessions. Book one session first to see how you find it.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="tile__img"><img src="/sites/optimal-health/assets/hifem-chair-room.jpg" alt="The HIFEM chair and its console, empty, a cushion on the seat and a side table alongside" loading="lazy" /></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band--sage" data-chapter="What people notice" id="s03" aria-label="What people notice">
  <div>
    <div class="says" style="margin-bottom:clamp(28px,3.4vw,44px)">
      <div class="body">
        <h2 class="lede">What people use it for.</h2>
        <p style="margin-top:22px">Pelvic floor support is the main reason people book HIFEM. How soon you notice a difference varies from person to person.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="tile__img"><img src="/sites/optimal-health/assets/hifem-session-seated-alt.jpg" alt="A client seated on the HIFEM chair, fully clothed, part-way through a session" loading="lazy" /></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid3 grid3--two" data-stagger>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Pelvic floor support</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>May help with leaks on coughing, sneezing, running or lifting, including after pregnancy and through menopause</li>
          <li>Helps you use your pelvic floor muscles in everyday tasks and during exercise</li>
          <li>Helps the pelvic floor and deep core muscles work together, which may take some strain off the back and hips</li>
          <li>Men use it too, for the same pelvic floor and core support</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Everyday energy</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Your muscles work while you sit</li>
          <li>Reaches muscles that are hard to contract on your own</li>
          <li>Many people say they feel energised afterwards</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Circulation</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Working muscle can support blood flow and lymphatic drainage</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Muscle and joint comfort</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Helps ease stiffness in the hips and lower back after long periods of sitting</li>
          <li>Supports comfortable joints and easier everyday movement</li>
          <li>People often find their hips and lower back feel looser afterwards</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band" data-chapter="Questions" id="s04" aria-label="Questions">
  <div>
    <div class="band__head">
      <div class="band__head__l">
        <h2 class="lede">Common questions.</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="qa" data-stagger>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Do I have to undress?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>No. You stay fully clothed for the whole session, pelvic floor sessions included.</p>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">What does it feel like?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>You'll feel a firm, rhythmic pulsing in the muscles you're sitting on. It comes in bursts with short pauses. It should feel strong, but not sharp. We start low and turn it down whenever you ask.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">How many sessions before I notice a difference?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>It varies. Some people find their hips and lower back feel looser after the first session. For the pelvic floor, it usually takes a few weeks of regular sessions.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Is this the same as doing pelvic-floor exercises?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>No, and it doesn't replace them. With exercises, you contract the muscle yourself. HIFEM makes the muscle contract for you, which helps most if you find the muscle hard to feel. Keep doing your exercises and follow any advice from a women's health physio.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Can I use it if I have pelvic pain, or a prolapse?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Speak with your GP or a pelvic health physio before booking.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Is this a medical treatment?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>No. It's a wellness session to work your muscles and help with movement and everyday comfort. We don't diagnose or treat medical conditions.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Who should not use it?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Anyone with a pacemaker, neurostimulator or other implanted electronic device must not use it. If you're pregnant, have metal implants or have had recent surgery, talk to your GP before booking. If a doctor or other clinician has told you to avoid electromagnetic exposure, you should not use it.</p>
          <p>Tell us about any of these before you book. If there's any doubt, we'll wait until your GP says it's OK.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">What if I have a metal implant or an old injury?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Tell us about every implant and surgery, however long ago. Some metal implants are fine and some aren't. We follow your GP's or surgeon's advice.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Can I book while pregnant, or while trying to conceive?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Speak with your GP first. We won't go ahead during pregnancy unless your GP has cleared it. If it's not advised, we'll suggest one of our other therapies instead.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">How soon after having a baby can I use it?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Wait until after your six-week postnatal check, and only once you've been cleared for exercise at that check. When you book, tell us if you had any tearing or a caesarean section. We'll make sure it's suitable for you before your first session.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Is it safe, and are there side effects?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>It is generally well tolerated by anyone who passes the checks above. Some people notice brief tingling or mild tiredness in the muscles afterwards, like after a light gym session. A member of our team supervises every session, and we stop if anything doesn't feel right.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Will I be sore afterwards?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Most people feel loose afterwards. A few people notice a mild heaviness in the muscles, like after a light workout. It goes within a day. Drinking water and moving gently usually helps.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Can I train on the same day?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Yes. Many people book it on a light training day or after their main workout.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Can I combine it with the other therapies?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Yes, and most of our regular clients do. For example, some people book hyperbaric oxygen in the morning, infrared in the evening, and fit in HIFEM or a massage around those. Tell us what your week looks like and we'll help you space them out.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">How do I get started?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Book a single session. If you have questions, especially about pelvic floor support, ring us first on 083 867 2844.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/CustomEase.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  // `js` means GSAP loaded, nothing more -- it is not a proxy for whether
  // the visitor wants to watch it move. Stripping it for reduced motion too
  // (an earlier pass did) fed the CSS no-scripting fallbacks -- the nav
  // sheet, the therapies panels, both keyed on html:not(.js) -- to a
  // visitor whose nav__menu click handler two IIFEs down works perfectly
  // well; the sheet then had no toggle, no way to close, and being
  // `position:absolute` sat over the page instead of in it. Scripting and
  // motion are different questions, so they get different signals: `js`
  // stays for as long as GSAP is actually running, and `calm` below alone
  // decides which animations fire.
  if (!window.gsap) { root.className = root.className.replace(/\bjs\b/, ''); return; }
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
  if (window.CustomEase) gsap.registerPlugin(CustomEase);
  var calm = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---- one easing vocabulary, used by everything ----------------------
     "Smooth but with a snap" is a curve that leaves fast and lands slow:
     most of the distance is covered in the first third, then it settles
     without bouncing. cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) is that curve. Built-in
     power/expo eases are close but symmetrical-feeling by comparison --
     they ramp rather than launch.

     SNAP   the house ease. Entrances, panels, anything that arrives.
     GLIDE  softer, for things already on screen that shift position.
     PRESS  short and tight, for hover and other direct responses.

     Durations matter as much as the curve: a snappy ease over 1.4s still
     reads as slow, and over 0.2s reads as a jump. These are tuned to the
     distances actually travelled on this site.
  --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var SNAP = window.CustomEase ? CustomEase.create('snap', '.16,1,.3,1') : 'expo.out';
  var GLIDE = window.CustomEase ? CustomEase.create('glide', '.22,.78,.24,1') : 'power3.out';
  var PRESS = window.CustomEase ? CustomEase.create('press', '.3,.9,.2,1') : 'power2.out';
  var EASE = SNAP;

  // Every scroll-triggered entrance and parallax below is the motion
  // `calm` opts out of. Skipping the setup is enough on its own -- nothing
  // is left stuck mid-transition, because nothing ever starts one -- as
  // long as the resting values it would have animated TO are also the CSS
  // values a `js` html element carries before any of this runs. They are:
  // the reduced-motion query beside the `.js` pre-animation states in
  // _style.css restates every one of them.
  if (!calm) {
    if (document.querySelector('.hero')) {
      var tl = gsap.timeline();
      tl.to('.hero__media img', { scale: 1, duration: 2.4, ease: GLIDE }, 0)
        .to('.hero__mark > span', { y: '0%', duration: 1.05, ease: SNAP }, 0.1)
        .to('.hero [data-rise]', { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: .85, ease: SNAP, stagger: 0.08 }, 0.28);
      gsap.to('.hero__media img', {
        yPercent: 10, ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.hero', start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: true }
      });
    }

    // Photographs wipe up as they are reached, and drift a little
    // while they are on screen.
    gsap.utils.toArray('.duo__img img, .tile__img img').forEach(function (img) {
      gsap.to(img, {
        clipPath: 'inset(0% 0 0 0)', scale: 1, duration: 1.15, ease: SNAP,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: img, start: 'top 88%' }
      });
    });
    gsap.utils.toArray('.duo__img').forEach(function (box) {
      gsap.fromTo(box.querySelector('img'), { yPercent: -3 }, {
        yPercent: 3, ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: box, start: 'top bottom', end: 'bottom top', scrub: true }
      });
    });

    // Section heads arrive in sequence -- every [data-rise] in them, not
    // just the .title. The stylesheet hides ALL [data-rise] at opacity 0 and
    // relies on something here to bring each one back. While this selector
    // was .title only, the "explore" links sitting beside three home-page
    // headings were hidden by the CSS and restored by nothing: invisible on
    // the live page since the site was built. Reveal what you hide.
    //
    // The .title inside a .band__head is in the query for the same reason,
    // from the other direction. The stylesheet hides that selector too, on its own
    // line, whether or not the element also carries [data-rise] -- so a head
    // whose eyebrow was written without the attribute (therapies has two,
    // massage one, and every article's "Read next") was hidden by the CSS
    // and reached by nothing here, leaving an eyebrow-shaped hole above the
    // heading on the live page. The query now matches what the CSS hides,
    // which is the only version of this that cannot drift again.
    gsap.utils.toArray('.band__head').forEach(function (head) {
      var rise = head.querySelectorAll('[data-rise], .title');
      if (!rise.length) return;
      gsap.to(rise, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: .8, ease: SNAP, stagger: 0.06,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: head, start: 'top 92%' } });
    });
    gsap.utils.toArray('.roll').forEach(function (roll) {
      gsap.to(roll.querySelectorAll('.roll__row'), {
        opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: .85, ease: SNAP, stagger: 0.07,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: roll, start: 'top 84%' }
      });
    });

    // The closing wordmark lifts into place like the one at the top.
    if (document.querySelector('.foot__mark > span')) {
      gsap.to('.foot__mark > span', {
        y: '0%', duration: 1.05, ease: SNAP,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.foot__mark', start: 'top 95%' }
      });
    }
  }

  /* ---- the therapies: hover to reveal, tap to open --------------------
     One panel open at a time. On a fine pointer the row opens on hover and
     the whole list closes when the pointer leaves it, so browsing the four
     is a single continuous movement rather than four clicks. On touch --
     where there is no hover -- the head toggles, which is also what a
     keyboard gets, and the link to the full page sits inside the panel so a
     press never navigates by surprise.

     Height is animated to a measured pixel value rather than 'auto': auto
     forces a layout read mid-tween and the first frame stutters, which is
     exactly the jolt this is meant to avoid.

     This wiring runs even when `calm` is true, unlike the reveals above:
     opening a panel is content the visitor asked for, not decoration that
     happened to them, so a reduced-motion visitor still gets a working
     accordion -- every duration below just collapses to zero.
  --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var rolls = gsap.utils.toArray('.roll--therapies');
  rolls.forEach(function (roll) {
    var rows = gsap.utils.toArray('[data-therapy]', roll);
    var open = null;

    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var head = row.querySelector('.roll__head');
      var panel = row.querySelector('.roll__panel');
      var img = row.querySelector('.roll__media img');
      var copy = row.querySelectorAll('.roll__body, .roll__go');
      if (!head || !panel) return;

      row._close = function (now) {
        if (!row.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
        row.classList.remove('is-open');
        head.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        gsap.killTweensOf([panel, img, copy]);
        var instant = now || calm;
        gsap.to(panel, {
          height: 0, duration: instant ? 0 : 0.42, ease: GLIDE,
          onComplete: function () { panel.hidden = true; }
        });
        gsap.to(copy, { opacity: 0, y: 8, duration: instant ? 0 : 0.2, ease: PRESS });
      };

      row._open = function () {
        if (row.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
        if (open && open !== row) open._close();
        open = row;
        row._openedAt = Date.now();
        row.classList.add('is-open');
        head.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        panel.hidden = false;
        gsap.killTweensOf([panel, img, copy]);

        // Measure the natural height with the panel laid out but not painted
        // at that size yet, then animate to the number.
        gsap.set(panel, { height: 'auto' });
        var target = panel.offsetHeight;
        gsap.fromTo(panel, { height: 0 }, { height: target, duration: calm ? 0 : 0.62, ease: SNAP });

        // The photograph wipes up and settles out of a slight overscale --
        // the same move the section images make when they scroll in, so the
        // panel feels like part of the page rather than a widget. Calm
        // visitors get the same open, just without the settle.
        gsap.fromTo(img,
          { clipPath: 'inset(0 0 100% 0)', scale: 1.06 },
          { clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0% 0)', scale: 1, duration: calm ? 0 : 0.85, ease: SNAP, delay: calm ? 0 : 0.05 });
        gsap.fromTo(copy,
          { opacity: 0, y: 14 },
          { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: calm ? 0 : 0.6, ease: SNAP, stagger: calm ? 0 : 0.07, delay: calm ? 0 : 0.12 });
      };

      // On a desktop the pointer opens a row on its way to clicking it, so a
      // click that arrives within a moment of that open is the visitor asking
      // for the row they are already looking at -- closing it there read as
      // the click doing the opposite of what was asked. A click on a row that
      // has been open a while still closes it.
      head.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!row.classList.contains('is-open')) row._open();
        else if (Date.now() - (row._openedAt || 0) > 600) row._close();
      });
      // Open on KEYBOARD focus only. A tap or a click also focuses the
      // button, a moment before the click lands -- so opening on every focus
      // meant a tap opened the row and the click that followed closed it
      // again, and on a phone that focuses buttons on tap (Android Chrome)
      // the list could not be opened at all. Found 2026-10-01 building the
      // massage price list on this same dropdown; the home page had it too.
      // :focus-visible is true for keyboard focus and false for a tap or a
      // click; a browser too old to know it throws, and opens as before.
      head.addEventListener('focus', function () {
        var keyboard = true;
        try { keyboard = head.matches(':focus-visible'); } catch (e) {}
        if (keyboard) row._open();
      });
    });

    // Hover only where hovering is real. A coarse pointer that reports hover
    // (some hybrids) would otherwise open a panel on the tap that was meant
    // to close it.
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches) {
      rows.forEach(function (row) {
        row.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { row._open(); });
      });
      roll.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
        if (open) { open._close(); open = null; }
      });
    }
  });

  // Card and row groups that arrive together, same rule as the reveals
  // above: skipped for calm, not merely instant -- .js [data-stagger]>* in
  // _style.css already carries the resting values.
  if (!calm) {
    gsap.utils.toArray('[data-stagger]').forEach(function (group) {
      gsap.to(group.children, {
        opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.85, ease: SNAP, stagger: 0.07,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: group, start: 'top 85%' }
      });
    });
  }
}());

/* ---- the nav Menu disclosure ------------------------------------------
   Its own IIFE, deliberately: the motion IIFE above still returns early
   when GSAP itself never loads, and a reader in that state still has to be
   able to open the menu. Reduced motion no longer forces that return --
   see the `calm` flag above -- so this is now the only fallback CSS keys
   off html:not(.js): genuinely no scripting at all, not "scripting but no
   animation". This only adds what CSS cannot: a click target below the
   breakpoint, moving focus into the sheet on open (the disclosed links
   sit before this button in the markup -- see the nav() comment in this
   file for why Book cannot move), Escape to close, and closing on an
   outside click. Book never lives behind this toggle; it is a sibling in
   the markup, not a link this script could hide.
--------------------------------------------------------------------- */
(function () {
  var nav = document.querySelector('.nav');
  var menu = document.querySelector('.nav__menu');
  var links = document.getElementById('nav-links');
  if (!nav || !menu || !links) return;
  var setOpen = function (open) {
    nav.classList.toggle('nav--open', open);
    menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    menu.textContent = open ? 'Close' : 'Menu';
    // The links sit before this button in the DOM (Book must stay put --
    // see nav()), so a forward Tab from the button would otherwise walk
    // straight past them into the page. Send focus in on open instead: the
    // first link becomes reachable immediately, and Tab from there walks
    // the rest of the sheet before it reaches Book and Menu again.
    if (open) {
      var first = links.querySelector('a');
      if (first) first.focus();
    }
  };
  menu.addEventListener('click', function () {
    setOpen(!nav.classList.contains('nav--open'));
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && nav.classList.contains('nav--open')) {
      setOpen(false);
      menu.focus();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--open') && !nav.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false);
  });
}());

/* ---- the chapter rail ------------------------------------------------
   Its own IIFE, deliberately: the motion one above still returns early
   when GSAP itself is missing. The rail does not use GSAP at all, so it
   has to keep working in exactly that case. It is decoration for nobody.

   Progressive enhancement over a plain anchor list: with this script
   removed the rail still lists every section and every link still jumps
   to it. One handler drives both the desktop rail and the phone strip,
   because they are two renderings of the same anchor list.

   Position is decided by a line a quarter of the way down the viewport:
   the current chapter is the last one whose top has crossed it. That is
   deterministic, unlike ranking IntersectionObserver ratios, which
   reorder unpredictably when one section is much taller than another.
--------------------------------------------------------------------- */
(function () {
  var calm = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var railAnchors = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-rail]'));
  if (railAnchors.length) {
    var byId = {};
    railAnchors.forEach(function (a) {
      var id = a.getAttribute('data-rail');
      (byId[id] = byId[id] || []).push(a);
    });
    var ids = Object.keys(byId);
    var sections = ids.map(function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); })
                      .filter(Boolean);
    var current = null;
    var mark = function (id) {
      if (id === current) return;
      current = id;
      railAnchors.forEach(function (a) {
        a.classList.remove('is-on');
        a.removeAttribute('aria-current');
      });
      (byId[id] || []).forEach(function (a) {
        a.classList.add('is-on');
        a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
        // The stylesheet gates its smooth scrolling on the same preference,
        // and a pan nobody asked for is worse than one they can follow: a
        // reduced-motion reader gets the jump, everyone else the glide.
        var how = calm.matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth';
        var strip = a.parentNode;
        if (strip && strip.classList && strip.classList.contains('strip__nav')) {
          strip.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, a.offsetLeft - 16), behavior: how });
          return;
        }
        // The rail is a scroll container of its own, and the later pages carry
        // six and seven chapters: on a short viewport the lit entry can sit
        // outside the rail's visible range, which is the one thing the rail
        // exists to prevent. Only when it is really overflowing, though -- on
        // a page whose index fits, this would be a no-op that still cancels
        // whatever scroll the reader is in the middle of.
        var rail = a.closest && a.closest('.rail');
        if (!rail || rail.scrollHeight <= rail.clientHeight + 1) return;
        var into = a.getBoundingClientRect().top - rail.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        rail.scrollTo({
          top: Math.max(0, rail.scrollTop + into - (rail.clientHeight - a.offsetHeight) / 2),
          behavior: how
        });
      });
    };
    var queued = false;
    var settle = function () {
      if (queued) return;
      queued = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        queued = false;
        var line = window.innerHeight * 0.25;
        var pick = sections[0];
        sections.forEach(function (s) {
          if (s.getBoundingClientRect().top <= line) pick = s;
        });
        if (pick) mark(pick.id);
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', settle, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', settle);
    settle();
  }
}());

/* ---- the films: nothing from YouTube until somebody asks for it -------
   Its own IIFE, deliberately, and this is the one on the page where that
   matters most. The motion block at the top returns early whenever GSAP
   has not loaded, and a play control inside that return is a play control
   that does nothing on exactly the visit where everything else already
   went wrong. It is also outside the reduced-motion branches for the same reason
   the therapies accordion is: pressing play is content somebody asked
   for, not motion that happened to them.

   The markup ships a poster from this site's own assets/ inside an
   ordinary <a> to the video's YouTube page -- see the .film block in
   _style.css -- so with this script removed the films are still four
   working links and not four dead buttons. What this adds is the swap:
   the anchor is replaced, at the click and not before, by an iframe
   pointed at youtube-nocookie.com with autoplay on. No request reaches
   youtube.com, youtube-nocookie.com or ytimg.com until that click.
--------------------------------------------------------------------- */
(function () {
  var gos = document.querySelectorAll('.film__go[data-film]');
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(gos, function (go) {
    var id = go.getAttribute('data-film');
    var who = go.getAttribute('data-who') || '';
    var box = go.parentNode;
    if (!id || !box) return;
    // The name in the markup promises YouTube, because without this script
    // that is where the press goes. With it, the press plays here, so the
    // promise is rewritten to match what the control now does.
    go.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play the film of ' + who);
    go.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      // Cmd/ctrl/shift/middle-click still mean "open the YouTube page in a
      // new tab", which is what the href is for and what a reader who wants
      // the full page expects. Only a plain press is ours to intercept.
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
      if (typeof e.button === 'number' && e.button !== 0) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var frame = document.createElement('iframe');
      frame.className = 'film__frame';
      frame.title = 'The film of ' + who;
      frame.src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' + encodeURIComponent(id) +
        '?autoplay=1&rel=0&playsinline=1&modestbranding=1';
      frame.allow = 'accelerometer; autoplay; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share';
      frame.setAttribute('allowfullscreen', '');
      frame.setAttribute('referrerpolicy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
      box.replaceChild(frame, go);
      // The element that had focus has just left the document, which drops
      // focus to <body> -- a keyboard reader would be back at the top of the
      // page having just asked to watch something. An iframe is focusable;
      // put them in the thing they pressed, where the player's own controls
      // are the next tab stop.
      frame.focus();
    });
  });
}());

(function () {
  // The enquiry form, posted as JSON so the answer lands in the page instead
  // of bouncing the reader to a blank redirect. Its own IIFE, deliberately:
  // the motion block above returns early when GSAP has not loaded, and a
  // visitor who cannot see a confirmation is worse off than one who cannot
  // see an animation. Without this the form still works -- it is an ordinary
  // POST, and the route sends the reader back with ok=1 or err= in the query
  // string, which the last few lines here read on the way in.
  var forms = document.querySelectorAll('form[data-enquiry]');
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(forms, function (form) {
    // The hidden field carries a sensible default for a reader with no
    // scripting; with scripting we know the page they are actually on,
    // whichever host or mount the site is served from.
    var ret = form.querySelector('input[name="return"]');
    if (ret) ret.value = location.pathname;
    var ok = form.querySelector('.form__ok');
    var err = form.querySelector('.form__err');
    var btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      if (!window.fetch) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (err) err.hidden = true;
      var label = btn ? btn.textContent : '';
      if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Sending'; }
      var data = {};
      new FormData(form).forEach(function (v, k) { data[k] = v; });
      fetch(form.getAttribute('action'), {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'accept': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(data)
      }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (j) {
        if (j && j.ok) {
          if (ok) ok.hidden = false;
          // The fields go, the confirmation stays: leaving a filled form
          // under a thank-you reads as though nothing was sent, and invites
          // a second send of the same enquiry.
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(form.querySelectorAll('.field, button[type="submit"]'), function (el) { el.hidden = true; });
        } else if (err) {
          // The route's own words where it has them: it is the side that
          // knows whether this was a bad address, a refused option or a
          // throttle, and a generic apology would throw that away.
          err.textContent = (j && j.error) || 'Something went wrong. Please ring us instead.';
          err.hidden = false;
        }
      }).catch(function () {
        if (err) { err.textContent = 'Something went wrong. Please ring us instead.'; err.hidden = false; }
      }).then(function () {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
      });
    });
  });

  // The no-scripting path lands back here with the answer in the query
  // string. Reading it costs nothing and means the reader who posted the
  // form natively -- before this script ran, or with fetch missing -- is
  // told what happened rather than shown the same empty form again.
  var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if (q.get('ok') === '1' || q.get('err')) {
    var first = document.querySelector('form[data-enquiry]');
    if (first) {
      var fok = first.querySelector('.form__ok');
      var ferr = first.querySelector('.form__err');
      if (q.get('ok') === '1' && fok) fok.hidden = false;
      if (q.get('err') && ferr) { ferr.textContent = q.get('err'); ferr.hidden = false; }
      first.scrollIntoView();
    }
  }
}());
</script>

pages.title: Infrared Light Therapy Clonmel | Optimal Health
pages.desc: Red and near-infrared light therapy in Clonmel. A 12-minute session on a full-length bed, on your own in the room. Book online or call 083 867 2844.
pages.body:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
:root{
  --sage:#C7D2BB;
  --ink:#24231F;
  --plaster:#F2F3ED;
  --timber:#B0844F;
  --deep:#5E6B4E;

  --pad:clamp(20px,4.2vw,60px);
  --gap:clamp(14px,1.6vw,22px);
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--plaster);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:Inter,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(14px,1.05vw,16px);
  line-height:1.55;
  font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,p,figure,blockquote{margin:0}

.wordmark{
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:clamp(30px,9.15vw,132px);
  line-height:.9;
  letter-spacing:-.015em;
  font-weight:500;
  max-width:100%;
  overflow-wrap:break-word;
}
.title{
  font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,19px);
  line-height:1.2;
  letter-spacing:.045em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;
}
.panel__t{
  font-size:clamp(19px,1.9vw,26px);
  line-height:1.2;
  letter-spacing:.05em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;
}
.panel__s{
  font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px);
  color:var(--deep);
  margin-top:8px;
}
.lede{
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,21px);
  line-height:1.45;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
  font-weight:400;
  max-width:44ch;
}
.micro{
  font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;
}
.body{max-width:58ch}
.body p + p{margin-top:1em}

.spread{
  border-top:1px dotted rgba(36,35,31,.42);
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
  padding-top:12px;
}
.on-ink .spread{border-top-color:rgba(242,243,237,.42)}

@media (max-width:640px){
  .spread{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px 18px}
}

.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  text-decoration:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:inherit;
  font-size:clamp(11px,.9vw,13px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;
  padding:14px 22px;border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--plaster);
  transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease;
}
.btn::after{content:"+";font-size:1.15em;line-height:0;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn:hover,.btn:focus-visible{background:var(--timber);color:var(--ink)}
.btn--light{background:var(--plaster);color:var(--ink)}
.btn--light:hover,.btn--light:focus-visible{background:var(--timber)}
.explore{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;
  font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;
}
.explore::after{content:"+";opacity:.75}
.explore:hover,.explore:focus-visible{color:var(--deep)}

.band--sage .explore:hover,.band--sage .explore:focus-visible{color:var(--ink)}

.nav{
  position:absolute;top:clamp(14px,1.8vw,26px);left:clamp(14px,1.8vw,26px);z-index:20;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,44px);
  background:var(--plaster);
  padding:12px 16px;border-radius:6px;
}
.nav__logo{width:clamp(104px,9vw,128px);height:auto}
.nav__links{display:flex;gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,20px)}
.nav__links a{
  text-decoration:none;
  font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,12px);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;
}

.nav__links a:hover,.nav__links a:focus-visible{color:var(--deep)}
.nav__cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.nav__menu{display:none;appearance:none;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;border-radius:0}

@media (max-width:900px){

  .nav{position:relative;top:0;left:0;border-radius:0;width:100%;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}

  .nav:has(+ .hero){position:absolute;top:0;left:0}
  .nav__links{
    display:none;

    order:1;flex-basis:100%;
    position:static;
    flex-direction:column;gap:0;
    background:var(--plaster);
    padding:4px 16px 14px;

    box-shadow:0 18px 36px -22px rgba(36,35,31,.4);
  }
  .nav--open .nav__links,html:not(.js) .nav__links{display:flex}
  .nav__links a{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(36,35,31,.28)}
  .nav__links a:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .nav__menu{display:inline-flex}

  html:not(.js) .nav__menu{display:none}
}

.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink)}
.hero__media{position:absolute;inset:0}
.hero__media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

.hero__media::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(36,35,31,.30) 0%,rgba(36,35,31,0) 24%,rgba(36,35,31,.06) 44%,rgba(36,35,31,.55) 72%,rgba(36,35,31,.82) 100%);
}
.hero__inner{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:var(--pad);color:var(--plaster);width:100%}
.hero__eyebrow{position:absolute;top:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);right:var(--pad);z-index:2;color:var(--sage)}

.hero__inner > p.micro{
  display:inline-block;
  background:var(--ink);
  padding:7px 12px 6px;
}
.hero .spread{border-top-color:rgba(242,243,237,.55);color:var(--plaster);margin-bottom:clamp(16px,2.4vw,28px)}

.hero__mark{margin-bottom:clamp(14px,2vw,22px)}

.hero__foot{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:clamp(26px,3vw,36px) 24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero__sub{color:var(--sage);max-width:38ch}
.hero__sub + .hero__foot{margin-top:clamp(26px,3vw,36px)}

.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:min(78vh,760px)}
@media (max-width:820px){.duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.duo__img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink);min-height:52vh}
.duo__img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.duo:hover .duo__img img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.duo__panel{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;
  padding:clamp(36px,6vw,84px) clamp(24px,5vw,72px);
  gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,28px);
}
.duo__panel--sage{background:var(--sage)}

.duo__panel--sage .panel__s{color:var(--ink)}
.duo__panel--plaster{background:var(--plaster)}
.duo__panel--ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--plaster)}
.duo__panel--ink .panel__s{color:var(--sage)}

.duo__panel--deep{background:var(--deep);color:var(--plaster)}

<section class="band band--sage" data-chapter="What it feels like" id="s01" aria-label="What it feels like">
  <div>
    <div class="says">
      <div class="body">
        <h2 class="lede">What a session feels like.</h2>
        <p style="margin-top:22px">You undress and lie down, and the bed warms up over twelve minutes. The heat comes from red and near-infrared light. The air doesn't get hot, so you barely sweat.</p>
        <p>The light can't get through clothes, so wear as little as you're comfortable with. Underwear is fine.</p>
        <p>Most people book it in the evening, because it's easier to wind down afterwards than to go back to work. If you book it in the morning, it can give you energy for the day.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="tile__img"><img src="/sites/optimal-health/assets/infrared-session-start.jpg" alt="A staff member's hand on the infrared bed's control panel, a client already lying inside the open end" loading="lazy" /></div>
    </div>
    <div class="cols4" data-stagger style="margin-top:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px)">
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">01</p><p class="cell__v">Arrive hydrated and skip a heavy meal beforehand.</p></div>
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">02</p><p class="cell__v">A member of our team shows you in, sets the bed up and leaves you to it.</p></div>
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">03</p><p class="cell__v">You lie on the bed for twelve minutes, on your own in the room. Most people close their eyes.</p></div>
      <div class="cell"><p class="roll__n">04</p><p class="cell__v">Have a glass of water, then carry on with your day.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band" data-chapter="How it works" id="s02" aria-label="How it works">
  <div>
    <div class="band__head">
      <div class="band__head__l">
        <h2 class="lede">How it works.</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <ul class="vitals" data-stagger>
      <li>
        <p class="vitals__k">Session length</p>
        <p class="vitals__v">12 minutes</p>
        <p class="vitals__m">The bed runs for twelve minutes. The whole visit takes less than half an hour.</p>
      </li>
      <li>
        <p class="vitals__k">How often</p>
        <p class="vitals__v">Two or three a week</p>
        <p class="vitals__m">Plan it by the week. The guide below is set out week by week for that reason.</p>
      </li>
      <li>
        <p class="vitals__k">Mostly booked for</p>
        <p class="vitals__v">Winding down</p>
        <p class="vitals__m">Also booked for tight muscles and joints, and for skin. Usually in the evening.</p>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div class="says">
      <div class="body">
        <p>The bed gives off red and near-infrared light at five wavelengths: 633, 660, 810, 850 and 940 nm. Red is the light you can see. Near-infrared is invisible and reaches deepest into tissue.</p>
        <p>Cells absorb this light, mainly in the mitochondria, the part of the cell that makes energy. The current understanding is that they can then make more usable energy.</p>
        <p>With more energy, cells can do more of their normal work. Collagen-making cells can lay down more collagen. Small blood vessels can widen to bring in more oxygen and nutrients. Irritated tissue can settle. These changes build over a course of sessions.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="tile__img"><img src="/sites/optimal-health/assets/infrared-bed-detail.jpg" alt="Close on the Optimal Health name set into the bed's shell, under a red wash" loading="lazy" /></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band--ink on-ink">

      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:20px;color:var(--sage)">633 · 660 · 810 · 850 · 940 nm</p>
      <p style="margin-top:20px">Five wavelengths of red and near-infrared light, and no ultraviolet.</p>

</section>

<section class="band band--sage" data-chapter="What people notice" id="s03" aria-label="What people notice">
  <div>
    <div class="band__head">
      <div class="band__head__l">
        <h2 class="lede">What people use it for.</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid3 grid3--two" data-stagger>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Rest and wind-down</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Promotes deep relaxation after a busy or stressful day</li>
          <li>Often used in the evening to support a steadier sleep routine</li>
          <li>Can help you switch off</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Muscle and joint comfort</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Helps tight muscles relax, especially in the hips, back and shoulders</li>
          <li>Supports joint comfort and easy range of movement</li>
          <li>Eases stiffness from sitting, commuting or training</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Circulation</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Gently encourages local blood flow</li>
          <li>May support the delivery of oxygen and nutrients to the area being warmed</li>
          <li>Encourages lymphatic drainage</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="panel__t" style="text-align:left">Skin and collagen</h3>
        <ul class="body">
          <li>Supports the body's own collagen production</li>
          <li>Supports circulation to the skin</li>
          <li>May support the skin's natural renewal</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
    <h2 class="lede" style="margin-top:clamp(44px,5vw,68px)">The first twelve weeks.</h2>
    <p class="body" style="margin:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px) 0 clamp(24px,3vw,36px)">This is what the research suggests is happening at each stage. It's still being studied, so use the weeks as a rough guide.</p>
    <ol class="arc" data-stagger>
      <li class="arc__row">
        <p class="arc__k">Weeks 1–2</p>
        <div>
          <p class="arc__t">Circulation.</p>
          <p class="arc__b">In the first two weeks, the light is thought to work on cell energy and circulation. Blood flow can increase and inflammation can settle, so tissue may feel calmer and less tight. No collagen has been rebuilt yet.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="arc__row">
        <p class="arc__k">Weeks 4–6</p>
        <div>
          <p class="arc__t">Building collagen.</p>
          <p class="arc__b">Collagen-making cells can start laying down new collagen, along with the molecules that hold water in the skin. Skin can feel springier and better hydrated. Eating enough protein and vitamin C helps, because the body builds collagen from them.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="arc__row">
        <p class="arc__k">Weeks 8–12+</p>
        <div>
          <p class="arc__t">Reorganising.</p>
          <p class="arc__b">Later, the collagen fibres are thought to reorganise and strengthen, while the enzymes that break collagen down slow. After twelve weeks, the aim is to keep it up with regular sessions.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band" data-chapter="Questions" id="s04" aria-label="Questions">
  <div>
    <div class="band__head">
      <div class="band__head__l">
        <h2 class="lede">Common questions.</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="qa" data-stagger>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Is it a sunbed?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>No. Sunbeds use ultraviolet light, and this bed uses none. It runs on red and near-infrared light, so there's no tanning and no burning.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Is this a medical treatment?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>No. It's a wellness session to help you relax and rest. We don't diagnose or treat medical conditions. If you have one, follow your doctor's advice and tell us before you book.</p>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">What do I wear, and do I have to undress?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Yes. Clothing blocks the light, so the less you wear, the more of your skin it reaches.</p>
          <p>Underwear is fine. It's your choice.</p>
          <p>You're on your own in the room. We set the bed up, check you're comfortable and leave you to it.</p>
          <p>Arrive hydrated and skip a heavy meal beforehand.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Will I sweat?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>A little, or not at all. It feels like a comfortable warmth. Have a glass of water afterwards.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Can I use it on the same day as training?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Yes. Many people train earlier and book the bed in the evening to wind down. It adds no training load, so it also suits a rest day.</p>
          <p>For example, some people book hyperbaric oxygen in the morning, infrared in the evening, and HIFEM or a massage when they have time. Tell us what your week looks like and we'll help you space them out.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="qa__row">
        <summary class="qa__q">Who should check with a GP first?</summary>
        <div class="qa__a">
          <p>Please check with your GP first if you're pregnant or trying to conceive, or if you have a cardiovascular condition, heat intolerance or a photosensitive condition.</p>
          <p>The same applies if you take medication that makes you more sensitive to light. This includes some antibiotics, acne and retinoid medication, some diuretics and anti-inflammatories, and St John's Wort. If you're on anything, check the leaflet or ask your pharmacist, and tell us before you book.</p>
          <p>If you have skin sensitivities, ask your GP or dermatologist. For teenagers we need guardian consent, and for older adults with health considerations we may ask for GP guidance before going ahead.</p>
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
